relationships.shinguji-kurono: Accepts Kurono's request to stay behind because her medical value is greater than her front-line value.
relationships.toka-todo: Is called to examine Toka after Toka collapses from Tendo's death-vision.

periods.summary: Kiriko appears in the Daien response meeting after rushing from Hiroshima to aid Kyushu. Although her water-user combat ability is acknowledged as strong, Kurono asks her to remain at the hospital because many wounded require a doctor and some cases specifically need her. Kiriko accepts immediately. She is also called when Toka collapses after the meeting, reinforcing her role as the indispensable medical support for the disaster response.

key_events.summary: Agrees to stay in the hospital rather than join the attack so she can treat victims.
